title: Design Spec Schema
description: Strict schema for Design Spec handoff from agent-isdd to agent-tdd. Includes requirements, design, research findings, and pre-fetched file summaries.

requirements_md.description: Full approved requirements.md from requirements phase

design_md.description: Full approved design.md with Research Basis section documenting wide-pass candidates and deep-pass findings

research_cache.description: Cached research findings from design-author's research-consolidator pass

design_findings.description: Design-ready findings: touchpoints, interfaces, design risks

task_findings.description: Task-ready findings: file boundaries, test surfaces, slicing constraints, migration risks

file_summaries.description: Summaries of touched files (exported from agent-nelly cache or generated by research-consolidator)

summary.description: Brief description of file purpose and key behavior

constraints.description: Known constraints: singleton, immutable, re-entrant, etc.

tech_debt.description: Known tech debt or code smells in this file

test_surface.description: How to test this file effectively (mocking strategy, fixtures, etc.)

git_hash.description: Git commit hash this summary was generated at (for staleness detection)

git_hashes.description: Git commit hashes for cache freshness validation (path -> hash)

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when cache was generated

intent_hash.description: SHA256 hash of intent.md for drift detection

research_scope.description: What this research was scoped for (e.g., 'Design (for Tasks)')

file_summaries.description: Pre-fetched file summaries from agent-nelly cache (if available), indexed by path for quick lookup during slicing

recap_md.description: Recap artifact summarizing requirements, design, known risks, blockers, and goal alignment notes
